exercises: Choose the correct past form: ①아침에 창문을 (닫았어요 / 닫었어요). ②지난달에 한국어 책을 (읽았어요 / 읽었어요). ③어제는 날씨가 (좋았어요 / 좋었어요).
Answer in Korean. Use the past form of the words given: ①A: 어제 뭐 했어요? B: (공원에서 운동하다) ____ ②A: 도서관은 어땠어요? B: (아주 조용하다) ____
Write the short (one-syllable) past form: ①나오다: 지하철역에서 3번 출구로 ____. ②배우다: 작년에 태권도를 ____. ③끓이다: 동생이 라면을 ____.
Fill in the blank with 이었어요 or 였어요: ①어제는 일요일____. ②그 사람은 제 고등학교 친구____.
Each sentence has one wrong word. Write the correct word: ①동생이 올해 대학생이 됬어요. ②어제는 피곤해서 일찍 자았어요. ③저는 작년까지 회사원였어요.

forms.when: The last vowel of the stem is ㅏ or ㅗ.
forms.exampleMeaning: I got flowers from a friend yesterday.

forms.when: The last vowel of the stem is any other vowel (ㅓ, ㅜ, ㅡ, ㅣ, etc.).
The verb or adjective ends in 하다.
forms.exampleMeaning: I cleaned my room on the weekend.

forms.form: short form: 가 → 갔, 오 → 왔, 주 → 줬, 마시 → 마셨, 되 → 됐
forms.when: The stem ends in a vowel with no final consonant. The stem and the ending join into one syllable.
forms.example: 어제 친구가 집에 왔어요. 같이 영화를 봤어요.
forms.exampleMeaning: A friend came to my place yesterday. We watched a movie together.

forms.when: Use 이었어요 after a final consonant (학생이었어요). Use 였어요 after a vowel (의사였어요).
forms.example: 어제는 친구 생일이었어요. 파티 장소는 카페였어요.
forms.exampleMeaning: Yesterday was my friend's birthday. The party was at a café.

objective: By the end, you can put verbs, adjectives and nouns into the polite past tense by choosing -았어요, -었어요, 했어요, -이었어요 or -였어요. You can also shorten vowel stems (가다 → 갔어요, 되다 → 됐어요) and fix three common spelling mistakes.
summary: Learn how to talk about the past politely with -았어요, -었어요, 했어요 and -(이)었어요.

title: 주말에 뭐 했어요? 지난 일 말하기
watchOut: 가았어요 (X) → 갔어요 (O): If the stem ends in ㅏ, don't add another 아. Just add ㅆ어요.
학생였어요 (X) → 학생이었어요 (O): 였어요 is only for nouns ending in a vowel. After a final consonant, use 이었어요.
됬어요 (X) → 됐어요 (O): 되 + 었 becomes 됐, not 됬. They sound the same, but 됬 is always a spelling mistake.
